corrections.reason: The preposition printed on the page is 1st-order 'ከ' (ከናንተ ጋራ), not 6th-order 'ክ'.
Both visually and grammatically the word is 'እንደሆነ' (1st-order ደ with a small ink speck near the right leg, parallel to 'እንደ ተዋሐደ' on the next line).

In Ge'ez grammar 'አዕይንቲሆሙ' takes the 3rd-person feminine plural verb 'ፆራ' (4th-order ራ, matching 'ወገዝፋ አልባቢሆሙ' in Col 3 L01 and the citation 'ፆራ ገዝፋ' in Col 3 L17), which is clearly printed on the page.
The printed text on Col 3 L11 has five glyphs 'እንዳላቸው' (without an extra 'ል').
Joined with 'ሳ-' at the end of L21, the negative subordinate verb is 'ሳይፈራ' (ending in 4th-order 'ራ', lacking the top-left serif of 6th-order 'ር' seen in 'ሳያፍር' right next to it).
